rank_scope: Full rank excludes fixed-integer-factor dependencies of the indicated equations. It does not rule out finite-field affine relations, selection of positions across primes, or spatial clustering.
echo_scope: Downsampling a monochrome run produces a shorter monochrome interval by multiplicativity. These deterministic echoes are not independent events and do not explain occurrence of their long parent.
control_scope: 37 deterministic neighbours matched by r, sigma and L; exploratory finite comparison, not a random sample or prospective primary test.
